[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run/step/run-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present preamble in the script (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the script starts with a line that re-runs it under bash -e when the image has bash, else it runs under sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: one Pipeline document per IR pipeline (each pipeline gets its own trigger)
